site_agreement.definition: Wargön is station 1 and station 2. Myrorna is station 3. Cross-site pairs join every Wargön annotation to every Myrorna annotation of the same gold id. Within-Wargön pairs are unordered pairs of Wargön annotations on those garments. Same view means the condition scores are equal. Same route means the usage labels are equal.

model_vs_expert.note: Model-versus-expert kappa compares each gold annotation with the model on that annotation's photographs. Expert-versus-expert kappa is pairwise between annotators of the same gold id.

router.placeholder_notice: Every number in this file is an illustrative placeholder for a portfolio demo. These are not life-cycle assessment results, not a sorting partner's prices, and not measured repair capacity.

attribute_baselines.inputs: annotation attributes only: condition, pilling, stains, holes, material, type, brand frequency, trend
attribute_baselines.brand_frequency: proportion of training rows with that brand string; a blank brand is one string; a brand absent from train is 0
attribute_baselines.note: Photographs are not used. Macro-F1, all 6 expert classes, is the ceiling for a model that is given these annotation attributes and predicts usage. Material, type, brand frequency, and trend are annotation fields.

station3.em_reference: Saerens, Latinne, and Decaestecker, Neural Computation 14(1), 2002

probability_source.rule_router: softmax of the illustrative route scores

station3.note: Each corrected prediction is the argmax of p(y|x) times a station 3 class prior divided by the training class prior. The labelled sample is a simple random sample of station 3 garments and is excluded from the scored rows. Its raw class shares are reported even when a class count is zero. Laplace smoothing adds one count to every class before dividing, so a class missing from the sample stays possible. The EM prior (Saerens, Latinne, and Decaestecker, 2002) is estimated from each model's p(y|x) on the scored rows and does not use station 3 labels. If that p(y|x) already puts more mass on a rare class than the training prior, the EM estimate can concentrate on that class. The router values being reweighted are a softmax of the illustrative route scores.
